thread:
incident-bot: Pager triggered -> tenant=heliumhealth severity=critical metric=tail_latency_95 p95=2100ms threshold=1500ms count_503=32
pagerduty: Incident PD-9821 fired and routed to eng-oncall. Trigger rule: reserved_pool_queue_depth > 80% for 3m. Escalation policy: oncall -> lead -> SRE.
maria gomez: Acked PD-9821. I'm on it, pulling logs and load charts.
ajay rao: Seeing correlated KV cache evictions on reservation-hr1-3, eviction_rate spike to 120/s. Could be prefix cache thrash.
leah-ops: HeliumHealth reports ~40% request error increase and slowdowns in realtime inference. customer-impact: degraded throughputs for write-heavy endpoints.
maria gomez: Quick triage: check reserved pool saturation and current hosts 
```bash
rwdctl reserved status --tenant heliumhealth --pool reserved-hr1
rwdctl metrics query "avg(latency_ms, p95) by host" --tenant heliumhealth
```
leah-ops: Logs from proxy show many 503s with message: "route_timeout: no available worker". Also some 429s.
timothy (oncall): Can we scale reserved pool up by 2 GPUs while we investigate? That should buy time.
ajay rao: I can run a scale but want to follow runbook. Runbook step: verify autoscale disabled, apply emergency-burst.
maria gomez: Confirmed autoscale=false on this reserved pool (customer requested fixed capacity). We'll do emergency burst per runbook.
maria gomez: Running command to add burst capacity now (will be temporary)
```bash
# emergency burst: add 2 worker nodes to reserved-hr1 for tenant heliumhealth
rwdctl reserved burst --tenant heliumhealth --pool reserved-hr1 --add-nodes 2 --ttl 30m
```
pagerduty: PD-9821 acknowledged by maria gomez at 1987654350.
incident-bot: Bridge created -> #incident-bridges/PD-9821 (auto-generated).
leah-ops: Noting mitigation: burst applied; watching metric windows. Please hold off on config changes until stabilization.
ajay rao: After burst applied, p95 dropped from ~2100ms -> ~850ms within 90s. 503s reduced to ~6 in last 2m. Looks like capacity pressure was main cause.
leah-ops: Customer success pinged HeliumHealth: Amy, we're applying temporary capacity and investigating root cause. Expecting improved latency within minutes.
cust-success-amy: Acknowledged, relaying to HeliumHealth support channel. They want ETA and whether requests were dropped: any data loss?
maria gomez: No persisted writes were lost; errors were surface-level 503s from fronting layer. We'll collect request IDs and give a post-incident summary.
timothy (oncall): Next steps: 1) keep burst for 30m 2) look at prefix distribution + cache eviction patterns 3) consider increasing KV cache size or switching to sticky routing for this tenant 4) decide whether to recommend migrating to Dedicated with headroom or adjust request throttles.
ajay rao: I'm pulling host-level traces and scheduler backlog. Early sign: burstbackpressure from heavy concurrent long-sequence requests causing KV miss storms.
leah-ops: Who is taking handoff when oncall shift changes in 10m? We should annotate PD incident with action items.
maria gomez: I'll own immediate triage and hand off to Ajay after I finish trace collection.
incident-bot: PD escalation timer = 15m until lead notified.
pagerduty: Note added to PD-9821: "Temporary burst added, p95 improved. Investigating KV cache thrash; follow up with cache sizing and routing changes."
cust-success-amy: HeliumHealth asked if we can provide throttling guidance to reduce cold-KV storms. Any recommended config?
ajay rao: Short-term: enable prefix-level rate limit at the edge for heavy keys, and increase kv_cache_capacity by 20% for reserved-hr1. Longer-term: change routing to include sticky-session for long-sequence workloads.
maria gomez: Patch to increase kv cache: 
```yaml
# config snippet (applied to reserved-hr1)
kv_cache:
  capacity_percent: 120
  eviction_policy: lru_ttl
```
leah-ops: I'm updating the incident doc with timeline and customer impact. tagging the SRE lead for postmortem.
timothy (oncall): If metrics hold for 15m, close PD-9821 to oncall and create follow-up ticket for platform to propose persistent capacity or routing change.
incident-bot: PD-9821 auto-note: "mitigation=burst; status=stabilizing; owner=maria gomez".
maria gomez: Confirming stabilization at 1987654800: p95 ~800ms, 503s back to baseline. I'll stay on watch for 10m then hand to Ajay for root-cause.
ajay rao: Will take post-triage. I'll capture flamegraphs and submit RCA ticket with suggested config changes.
cust-success-amy: Thanks — I'll update HeliumHealth that service is stable and that we'll follow up with mitigation and recommended config.
leah-ops: Closing notes for oncall: add runbook note to consider Burst->Persistent reservation transition if tenant consistently hits >70% for 15m windows.
maria gomez: PD-9821 resolved (manual) at 1987654975. Closing thread once Ajay files RCA ticket. :white_check_mark:
